reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2, E3) describes dual-phase microstructures, oxide film formation, and improved wear/corrosion resistance in various HEAs, but none provides direct support for the key premises of micro-galvanic coupling, nonuniform film formation, or synergistic degradation under simultaneous wear and corrosion. The evidence is only loosely related to the proposed mechanism.
premises: Multiphase eutectic HEA has distinct phases with different oxidation/electrochemical properties
These phases form localized micro-galvanic cells
Micro-galvanic cells cause nonuniform oxide film formation
Mechanical wear continuously ruptures the oxide film
Film rupture and reformation synergistically accelerate both wear and corrosion
